summary: include_vars loads YAML/JSON variables from a file or directory at task runtime, loading directory files alphabetically; use delegate_to with delegate_facts to assign them to another host.
questions: How do I load variables from a file during a play?
In what order are var files in a directory loaded?
How do I load variables onto a different host?

answer_card.title: Load variables at runtime with include_vars
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.include_vars` loads YAML/JSON vars from a file or directory (recursively) during runtime. Directory files are loaded **alphabetically**. To assign to another host, use `delegate_to` + `delegate_facts: yes`. Works on Windows.
